title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity - params, roles, stop/logprobs, response formatting, and streaming stability
author: Eliot Zhang
description: Motivation: Bring Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer for /v1/chat.completions to parity with common OpenAI semantics so product integrations behave identically across hosted and dedicated/private deployments. This PR implements parameter mapping for temperature/top_p/n/stop/presence_penalty/frequency_penalty, preserves user-provided role fields and system messages, surfaces stop sequence handling including legacy multi-stop behavior, provides logprobs passthrough where available, and tightens response formatting to match OpenAI shape (choices[*].message/content vs. text fallbacks). It also includes a collection of stability fixes for streaming function/tool calls to address truncation and reconnection cases observed in canary traffic. Checklist: [x] params mapping implemented and unit tested | [x] roles/system message preservation implemented | [x] stop sequence semantics added and fuzz-tested against legacy inputs | [x] logprobs passthrough implemented where backend provides logits | [x] streaming stability fixes implemented with reconnect/backpressure handling | [x] integration tests added for Python and TypeScript SDKs | [x] docs updated with examples and migration notes
commits: 4 commits: 1) openai-compat: map chat params + unit tests; 2) openai-compat: preserve roles and system messages across rerouting; 3) streaming: fix chunk framing and reconnection for function/tool calls; 4) docs + sdk examples for new parity behavior
files_changed: src/openai_compat/server.go, src/openai_compat/params.go, src/openai_compat/roles.go, src/openai_compat/stop_handler.go, src/openai_compat/logprobs_passthrough.go, src/openai_compat/streaming.go, tests/openai_chat_compat_test.go, tests/streaming_function_calls_test.go, sdk/python/openai_compat.py, sdk/typescript/openai_compat.ts, docs/openai_compat.md, integrations/compat_smoke_test.py
release_notes: Adds parity for OpenAI /v1/chat.completions: mapped params (temperature, top_p, n, penalties), preserved role semantics and system messages, stop sequence support including multi-stop behavior, logprobs passthrough when available, improved response formatting to match OpenAI shape, and streaming stability fixes for function/tool calls. No breaking changes expected; minor SDK examples updated.
merge: Merged after CI green and two approvals. Squashed commits into a single change and updated changelog entry.
